top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Oil Jump Fuels Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A renewed drop in bonds reduced bets on riskier corners of Wall Street, hitting stocks on worries that elevated oil prices will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The Quantum Stack and the Countdown to Q-Day
top_signals.summary:
Quantum’s hype obscures a reality with real geopolitical stakes: the technology works and is advancing every day. Cameron Chehreh (IonQ), JD Dulny (Booz Allen), and Ben Gianni (GDIT) join Jonathan to discuss the race to Q-Day. They cover the shift to post-quantum cryptography, competing hardware modalities, emerging use cases, and why talent gaps and fragile supply chains mean the United States could be at risk of falling behind.Image: Jonathan Steffen via DVIDS.

The post The Quantum Stack and the Countdown to Q-Day appeared first on War on the Rocks.
